order_wins: **Knowledge Marine & Engineering Works** — receives a **work order from Mumbai Port Authority for the chartering of one 60-tonne bollard-pull battery-operated electric green tug, Rs 279.33 crore including GST over 15 years**, with manning, operations, maintenance and complete technical management; its press release calls this the third Green Tug contract it has won from a Major Port _(~4.0% of mcap)_.

**Refex Industries** — bags a **contract from a public sector undertaking in Madhya Pradesh for the lifting of 10 lakh metric tonnes of pond ash and fly ash, ~Rs 160 crore**, under road-cum-rail mode over 18 months extendable by mutual consent; a same-day corrigendum corrects the quantity from the 10 MT first disclosed and leaves the value unchanged _(~4.3% of mcap)_.

**East India Drums and Barrels Manufacturing** — is awarded a **Rs 59.02 crore contract through the Government e-Marketplace by Hindustan Petroleum for the supply of IS-3575 bitumen drums**, to run two years and in the ordinary course of business _(~42.2% of mcap)_.

**Cosmic CRF** — the company and two subsidiaries, N.S. Engineering Projects and Cosmic Springs & Engineers, book **purchase orders of Rs 14.14 crore, Rs 11.80 crore and Rs 5.90 crore from an engineering and infrastructure customer in Kolkata** for fabricated structural steel, each for delivery within three months _(~2.7% of mcap; the Rs 31.84 crore total is our sum)_.
**Eleganz Interiors** — receives a **design-and-build contract worth INR 7,87,29,941 from a customer it identifies only as "Aviation Industry"**, to be executed by April 2027 _(~4.1% of mcap)_.

**Power & Instrumentation (Gujarat)** — receives a **Rs 6.06 crore work order excluding GST from Mahesh Solar Solution** for 11kV ICOG and inverter LT panels under the KUSUM-C feeder-solarisation scheme across 11 sites in Maharashtra, in five to six weeks from drawing approval _(~2.9% of mcap)_.
**Vdeal System** — is awarded a **Rs 5.40 crore order from existing client Mogli Labs (India) for the supply of a power distribution system**, for delivery by 15 January 2027.

**United Drilling Tools** — receives a **domestic order from ONGC for the supply of stabilizers, an estimated Rs 4.78 crore**, to be executed in six months and in the ordinary course of business _(~1.1% of mcap)_.

**Zodiac Energy** — takes **purchase orders from four Gujarat entities for grid-interactive ground-mounted solar PV plants totalling 24,760 kWp**, each for execution in six months; the filing withholds the buyers' names and states that all four are related-party orders in which its promoter group is interested, with no value disclosed.

**Chiraharit** — receives a **Rs 59.60 lakh purchase order including GST from the Northern Region Farm Machinery Training & Testing Institute at Hissar** for a centre-pivot irrigation system, installation included _(~1.1% of mcap)_.
fund_raises_fresh_equity: **United Heat Transfer** — shareholders approve issuing **29,68,000 equity shares at Rs 105.50 on a preferential basis for cash, Rs 31,31,24,000 in all**, to 17 identified non-promoters, of whom Intelliquity Ventures LLP takes 4.85% of the post-issue capital and Manju Singhi 1.64%.

**Gconnect Logitech and Supply Chain** — board approves **raising up to Rs 41 crore from existing shareholders through a rights issue** of Rs 10 face-value equity shares, subject to regulatory approvals; a revised outcome of the same meeting was filed later the same day.

**Choksi Laboratories** — board approves issuing **up to 3,50,000 fully convertible warrants at Rs 177 to the promoter and promoter group, Rs 6.20 crore in all**, a quarter payable on allotment, with an extraordinary general meeting set for 17 October _(~4.5% of mcap)_.

**Swastika Investmart** — its preferential allotment committee approves the **offer letter for 90,50,000 convertible warrants at not less than Rs 63.64** to promoter and public-category subscribers, on the August EGM resolution and BSE's in-principle approval of 18 September; the price is a floor, so no total is stated.
equity_allotments: **Hiliks Technologies** — allots **23,00,000 equity shares at Rs 72, Rs 16.56 crore, to five non-promoters including Aegis Investment Fund PCC at 9.15% and Niveza Small Cap Fund at 4.93%**, with 11,50,000 convertible warrants at the same price a quarter paid up _(~26.9% of mcap)_.

**Sumeet Industries** — allots **84,31,195 equity shares at Rs 33.21 to six non-promoters on conversion of optionally convertible redeemable preference shares, Rs 28.00 crore**, the preference shares having been issued in December 2024 under its NCLT-approved resolution plan, so no fresh cash comes in _(~4.2% of mcap)_.

**Dhansafal Finserve** — converts **1,00,00,000 warrants held by Luharuka Exports into equity on receipt of the balance 75%, Rs 3.23 crore**, taking that holder to 23.50% of an enlarged 23,71,40,000 shares _(~5.9% of mcap)_.

**Shree Rajeshwaranand Paper Mills** — reconsiders its 21 August preferential issue and **approves a revised list of proposed allottees**, leaving every other term of that decision unchanged, and will apply to BSE for in-principle listing approval.
m_and_a: **Rays of Belief (MOMSBELIEF)** — wholly owned Mom's Belief US Inc **acquires 100% of New York-based City Pro Group Inc for USD 2,000,000 in cash**, effective 18 September; the target, in pediatric early intervention and school-based special education, turned over USD 1,14,32,394.52 in the year to 30 June 2025.

**Jhaveri Credits & Capital** — board approves **acquiring 51% of U R Energy (Solar), a company with Rs 1 lakh of paid-up capital, nil turnover and negative net worth**, and puts to a postal ballot its own renaming to U R Energy (India) and a new solar main-objects clause.
**Electrosteel Castings** — pays **OMR 21,000 for 14,000 shares, 70% of Arabian Water Tech LLC of Oman**, and has received the share certificate, making the water-treatment company a subsidiary.

**K.M. Sugar Mills** — fixes **1 October as the effective date and 2 October as the record date for the NCLT-sanctioned demerger of its distillery division into KM Spirits and Allied Industries**, one Rs 10 share for every five Rs 2 shares held.

**Himadri Speciality Chemical** — will put to its board on **21 September a scheme of arrangement demerging the tyre business of Dalmia Bharat Refractories into the company**, and has closed its trading window until 48 hours after the outcome.

**MPS** — the NCLT at Chennai, by an order of **16 September on the second-motion petition for the amalgamation of ADI BPO Services into the company**, takes the shareholder and creditor approvals of 22 August on record and directs notice to the statutory authorities.

**Veranda Learning Solutions** — the Regional Director, Southern Region, **approves amalgamating wholly owned Veranda IAS Learning Solutions and step-down Neyyar Academy into Veranda Race Learning Solutions**; the company states this is distinct from its Commerce-vertical demerger.

**Shivalic Power Control** — completes the purchase of **51% of Seedlab Ventures for Rs 1.43 lakh in cash**, a related-party buy from its own promoter group meant to take it into solar parks; the filing revises the price from the Rs 1.37 lakh it first reported and puts Seedlab's FY26 turnover at Rs 2.49 crore.

**Shreenath Paper Products** — board approves buying **25,000 shares of associate Shreenath Paper Industries from Bijoy Ramesh Shah for Rs 2.50 lakh at face value**, lifting its holding from 50% to 75% and making it a subsidiary.

**Sainik Finance & Industries** — receives a Regulation 10(7) report for an **off-market inter-se transfer of 13,16,066 shares, 12.10% of its paid-up capital, among its promoters and promoter group**.
capex_core: **D.K. Enterprises Global** — acquires **leasehold rights to 5,000 sq m of land and a 60,000 sq ft building at Katha, Baddi, Himachal Pradesh for Rs 12.50 crore** excluding stamp duty, for a first-phase flexible-packaging unit it puts at about Rs 90 crore of added capacity against an existing Rs 140 crore, operational by end-2026.

**Stallion India Fluorochemicals** — **commences commercial operations from 21 September at its semiconductor and specialty-gas debulking and blending facility at Khalapur, Raigad**, an object of its January 2026 IPO prospectus and its entry into semiconductor gases.

**P N Gadgil Jewellers** — board approves an **additional investment of up to USD 6,500,000 in wholly owned PNG Jewelers INC**, by subscription to fresh equity in one or more tranches; the US company remains wholly owned.

**Ashnisha Industries** — **completes testing and commissioning and begins power generation at its solar project at Un, Taluka Kankrej, Banaskantha, Gujarat**, having already held the UGVCL, GEDA and GETCO approvals; it expects the plant to contribute to revenue.
business_updates: **Results season** — 3 companies filed results / earnings-call material today (press releases, recordings, transcripts, presentations) — tracked in the Results tab, not itemised here.

**Advait Energy Transitions** — step-down Advait Battery Ecosystems signs a **master supply agreement with Hithium for 314 Ah lithium iron phosphate prismatic cells, structured to support offtake of up to 1 GWh over the next year**, at a contractual USD 49.5 per kWh for the first 350 MWh, feeding its coming cell-to-container battery storage assembly plant.

**Neetu Yoshi** — receives **RDSO prototype approval for its Friction Wedge** and is now eligible to supply the component to Indian Railways, including for the CASNUB 22 RFT "Raftar" high-speed freight bogie; it is its 26th RDSO-approved railway item.

**Poddar Pigments** — enters a **strategic partnership with Sukano Polymers Corp of the USA for direct sales and distribution, local stock included, of its single pigment dispersion black, white and colour range across the United States, Canada and Latin America**, effective 9 September.

**Tirupati Forge** — receives an **industrial licence under the Indian Arms Act, 1959 to manufacture empty artillery shells** in calibres from 105mm to 155mm, including ERFB and base-bleed 155mm variants, on an initial capability of 150,000 units a year.

**MOS Utility** — subsidiary Samvriddhi Inclusive Growth Network **receives in-principle authorisation from the Reserve Bank of India to operate as an online payment aggregator**, subject to final authorisation, adding merchant payments to its business-correspondent network.

**Puravankara** — wholly owned Provident Housing **launches Phase 6 of its Provident Equinox residential project at Venkatapura, Kengeri, Bengaluru** on 20 September, registered with the Karnataka RERA.
distress_risk: **Goldiam International** — receives a **Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation property-tax demand of Rs 23,54,86,763 on its SEEPZ premises covering 1 April 2010 to 31 March 2026**, which it says it is examining before taking legal action to defend itself.

**Birla Corporation** — wholly owned RCCPL receives a **show-cause notice from the Additional Commissioner, CGST Jabalpur proposing recovery of Rs 15,02,51,383 of allegedly excess input tax credit for FY2022-23**, plus interest and penalty, over Bills of Entry that reached GSTR-2B after the Section 16(4) window; the company says the notice has no merit.

**JSW Energy** — the Appellate Tribunal for Electricity **sets aside a 2022 CERC order and allows step-down subsidiary JSW Hydro Energy's claim for notional interest during construction on equity above 30%**, remanding the data to CERC for a prudence check.

**Teerth Gopicon** — its **first committee of creditors approved 11 of 27 resolutions and rejected 16 on 1.32% support**, among them the confirmation of the interim resolution professional, who therefore continues as deemed resolution professional.
**Astron Paper and Board Mill** — under insolvency since 11 May, convened the **fifth meeting of its committee of creditors on 18 September**.
**Kalahridhaan Trendz Limited** — Kalahridhaan Trendz Limited has informed the Exchange about Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
credit_rating_changes: **Vishnu Prakash R Punglia** — Infomerics **downgrades the long-term rating to IVR C+/Stable and the short-term to IVR A4 on Rs 960 crore of bank facilities**, citing delays in servicing principal on unsecured short-term working-capital borrowings disclosed in the FY26 annual report; it puts the unexecuted order pipeline at about Rs 4,391 crore.

**CMR Green Technologies** — CRISIL **upgrades the long-term rating to AA-/Stable from A+/Stable and the short-term rating to A1+ from A1**, on bank facilities enhanced to Rs 953 crore from Rs 760.74 crore.

**Indo Farm Equipment** — Infomerics **upgrades it to IVR A/Stable and IVR A1 on Rs 103.70 crore of bank facilities**, citing deleveraging, a 14.39% rise in FY26 operating income and a structural cut in its exposure to subsidiary Barota Finance.
**Gopal Snacks** — CRISIL **reaffirms A and A1 on Rs 150.31 crore of bank facilities but revises the long-term outlook to Negative from Stable**.

**Century Extrusions** — refiles its 17 September intimation to say the rating action was misstated: Infomerics **reaffirmed IVR BBB and revised the outlook to Positive**, rather than upgrading the long-term rating as first reported.
other_notable: **Oseaspre Consultants** — **Nimesh Sahadeo Singh makes an open offer for 1,82,000 shares, 26% of emerging capital, at Rs 48 a share**, triggered by a board-approved preferential issue to him and a share purchase agreement of 18 September with the existing promoters.

**Technojet Consultants** — the **same acquirer makes a mirror open offer, 1,82,000 shares for 26% of emerging capital at Rs 48**, on the same structure and the same 18 September share purchase agreement, with Navigant as manager to both offers.

**Kalyan Jewellers India** — subscribes **Rs 350 crore to a rights issue of 17,50,000 shares at Rs 10 plus a Rs 2,000 premium by wholly owned Candere Lifestyle Jewellery**, the stated object being repayment of loans Kalyan itself had extended; its holding is unchanged at 100% _(~0.6% of mcap)_.

**Goyal Salt** — board approves investing **up to Rs 3 crore in subsidiary Goyal Foods Industries** and has subscribed 7,65,000 shares for Rs 76.50 lakh in that subsidiary's rights offer, lifting its holding there from 5,10,000 to 12,75,000 shares _(~1.7% of mcap)_.
**Emami Limited** — Emami Limited has informed the Exchange about public Announcement - Buyback of Shares
